blocks.html: Where a building faces upon four streets or public spaces, at least one Fire Department connection shall be provided on each street front or public space; however, only one Fire Department connection need be provided at the corner of two intersecting streets or public spaces if the Fire Department connection is located within 15 feet (4572 mm) of the corner and on the street with the longest building frontage or public space, and if the distances between Fire Department connections, in all cases, do not exceed 300 feet (91 140 mm).
